en.bdb: Todee, The Word Of The Devotees:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਿਰਵਾ ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥

transliteration.english: koiee bolai niravaa koiee bolai dhoor ||

en.bdb: Some say that He is near, and others say that He is far away.
We might just as well say that the fish climbs out of the water, up the tree. ||1||
Why do you speak such nonsense?

verse.unicode: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਛਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jin har paio tineh chhapaio ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: One who has found the Lord, keeps quiet about it. ||1||Pause||
Those who become Pandits, religious scholars, recite the Vedas,
but foolish Naam Dayv knows only the Lord. ||2||1||

verse.unicode: ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਤ ਹੀ ॥

transliteration.english: kaun ko kala(n)k rahio raam naam let hee ||

en.bdb: Whose blemishes remain, when one chants the Lord's Name?

verse.unicode: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਭਏ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: patit pavit bhe raam kahat hee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Sinners become pure, chanting the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਆਈ ॥

transliteration.english: raam sa(n)g naamadhev jan kau pratagiaa aaiee ||

en.bdb: With the Lord, servant Naam Dayv has come to have faith.

verse.unicode: ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: ekaadhasee brat rahai kaahe kau teerath jaae(n)ee ||1||

en.bdb: I have stopped fasting on the eleventh day of each month; why should I bother to go on pilgrimages to sacred shrines? ||1||
Prays Naam Dayv, I have become a man of good deeds and good thoughts.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥੨॥

transliteration.english: gurmat raam keh ko ko na baiku(n)Th ge ||2||2||

en.bdb: Chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions, who has not gone to heaven? ||2||2||
